primary_endpoint: Absolute change in hepatic fat fraction by MRI-PDFF from baseline to Week 12.
efficacy_outcome: MRI-PDFF liver fat change was −7.68 for Treatment A, −9.17 for Treatment B, and −1.54 for placebo; p<0.0001 for each treatment comparison (ANCOVA).
safety_signal: Serious AEs: Treatment A, 2/18 (1 death); Treatment B, 2/19 (0 deaths); placebo, 1/19 (1 death).
